reasoning_summary:
Phase E — System Lock: Runtime architecture enforcement layer.

(1) core/architecture_validator.py: AST-based scanner detecting forbidden imports (lancedb), lancedb.connect() calls, rag.store.table.* patterns, deprecated extraction scripts, and missing bootstrap imports. Exempts validator meta-files and scripts/ directory from scanning. 9 HIGH violations found (deprecated scripts) — no CRITICAL violations.

(2) core/bootstrap.py: Orchestrates startup. Runs project_memory_loader (session index, tasks, bugs, state) + architecture_validator. Provides startup_enforce() (refuses on CRITICAL violations), require_bootstrap() (scripts must call before execution), get_runtime_context().

(3) backend/main.py: Replaced system_validator.run_startup_validation() with bootstrap.startup_enforce() in FastAPI lifespan. Server now refuses startup on CRITICAL violations.

(4) 11 executable scripts: Added 'from core.bootstrap import require_bootstrap; require_bootstrap()' at top of each.

(5) reingest_all.py: Fixed real violation — rag.store.table.delete() → rag.store.delete_by_doc_id().

(6) control_center/SYSTEM_LOCK.md: Documents canonical ingestion/retrieval paths, forbidden patterns, allowed modules, verification command.
system_state_before: No runtime architecture enforcement. system_validator wired but non-blocking. Scripts ran without bootstrap context.
system_state_after: ArchitectureValidator blocks startup on CRITICAL violations. All 11 executable scripts enforce bootstrap. SYSTEM_LOCK.md documents all rules. 0 CRITICAL violations in codebase.
